title: Uniform marked-polygon estimates and sharp finite bridge moments
summary: We prove a uniform bound for critical honeycomb polygons through two axial marks on a periodic staircase. The bound retains an explicit power of the ratio between the period and the marked separation. We also prove sharp finite strip estimates: bridge mass of order h −1/4 , first-length mass at most $`Ch^{13/12}`$, and mass at least $`ch^{-1/4}`$ on bridges with length at least $`ch^{4/3}`$.
family_title: The three-quarter exponent for honeycomb self-avoiding walk

review.reason: Proves polygon bounds and sharp moment estimates for bridges on a periodic honeycomb staircase.
